audit.summary: CvTraitInfo #428 coverage+conflict+inventory audit complete. The 6 classify+verify slices (core-scalars, economy-scalars, military-religion-scalars, yield-commerce-indexed, cross-entity-keyed-CREST, booleans-devleaders-identity) cover all 134 AUTHORED fields with NO coverage gaps; the 19 DERIVED *Filtered/runtime twins are correctly excluded (do-not-migrate). Verify disagreed (agree=false) on 8 fields: MaxAnarchy + MinAnarchy (internal inconsistency: verdict=identity but record still carried an 'anarchy' family/scope/jsonPath -> must be CLEAN identity keys with no family, per the civic iAnarchyLength->identity precedent; MaxAnarchy carries the -1 default verbatim); WorkerSpeedModifier (family-name collision: civic=workRate vs first-mover tech=workerSpeed -> reconcile, lean workerSpeed); GoldenAgeDuration (precedent claim overstated -> downgrade to 'proposed, no committed precedent', path unchanged); CityStartCulture + BonusPopulationinNewCities (grant-vs-modifier unresolved + grant/grants singular/plural inconsistency -> corrected toward keep-modifier under a cityFounding family); GoldenAgeYieldChanges + GoldenAgeCommerceChanges (wrongly tagged crest=true/verdict=open -> these are a player STATE condition, the determinate goldenAge condition-member pattern, NOT an entity-conditioner crest; would falsely pollute the crest inventory). 3 GENUINE crest cases (do NOT auto-invert): BonusHappinessChanges (bonus conditioner; SCOPE corrected empire->city to match curate_bonus.py:30 fold convention), TechResearchModifiers (tech conditioner, but HANDOFF rules it STAYS trait-side as derived boostedBy). DOUBLE-AUTHOR-DROPs confirmed against curate_specialist.py:80-81: SpecialistYieldChange + SpecialistCommerceChange (specialist migrated first, folds the TraitInfo fields at empire/flat). 1 DEAD field: Categories (zero C++ readers, not even authored in trait data; civic also drops it). DEV-LEADERS relations (12, inventory-only no commitment): PrereqTrait/PrereqOrTrait1/PrereqOrTrait2/PrereqTech/DisallowedTraitTypes/OnGameOptions/NotOnGameOptions/LinePriority/PromotionLine + the culture-req game-option (not a trait field) + Categories(dead). Ground-truth verified: curate_specialist.py folds, curate_civic.py Categories-drop + anarchyLength-identity + workRate, curate_tech.py has NO per-build worker-speed edge (so BuildWorkerSpeedModifiers is NOT double-authored), curate_bonus.py folds bonus edges at city scope, and TraitInfo.json first-pass mapping (anarchy/flat, bonusHappiness/city) corroborates both corrections.
